main_text.p: עַגְבָּרָה[?] f. Adamatio, q.d. Amasiatio : Aff. עַגְבָּתָהּ[?] Amasiationem suam, Ezech.23.11.
עוּגָב[?] , עָגָב m. Organum, Instrumentum musicum, quasi Amabile dictum, Gen.4.21. Aff. וְעֻגָבִי[?] Et organum meum, Job.30.31.
עָגַן[?] Hinc deducunt תַּעֲנָגָה[?], quod vide in עגן[?].
עָגֹל m. Rotundum, 1.Reg.7.23. Plural.foemin. עֲגָלוֹת[?] Rotunda, 1.Reg.7.31.
עָגִיל m. Inauris, proprie Rotunda & circularis, Numer.31. v.50. Plural. עֲגִילִים[?], Ezech.16.12.

עֶגְלָה[?] f. Plaustrum, à rotundis rotis vel circulari rotarum motu sic dictum, 1.Sam.6.7. Aff. עַגְלָתוֹ[?] Plaustri sui, Jesa.28.28. Plural. עֲגָלוֹת[?] Plaustra, Gen.45.19. Constr. עֲגָלוֹת[?] Num.7.3.
עֵגֶל m. Vitulus, plaustralis proprie, unde generaliùs deinceps sumitur, Lev.9.2. Plural. עֲגָלִים[?] Vituli, 2.Reg.17.16. Constr. עִגְלֵי[?] 2.Par.13.8.

עֶגְלָה[?] f. Vitula, Gen.15.9. Constr. עֶגְלַת[?] Deut.21.3. עֶגְלַת שְׁלִישִׁיָּה[?] Vitula trima, Jef.15.5. per enallagen constructi pro absoluto, aut per ellipsin, pro עֶגְלַת יְלִידָה שְׁלִישִׁיָּה[?] Vitula partus tertii, qui robustior est, non trium annorum, ut R. Salomon docet. Aff. בְּעֶגְלָתִי[?] Cum vitula mea, Judic.14.18. Plur. Constr. לְעֶגְלוֹת[?] Vitulis Bethaven, Hof.10.5.

מַעְגָּל[?] m. Plaustrorum ambitus, ad munienda castra, quasi Plaustriburgium dicas ; Cum ה locali, הַמַּעְגָּלָה[?] Ad plaustrorum ambitum, 1.Sam.17.20. Item Orbita, via plaustralis, habens orbitas sive rotarum vestigia ; Constr. מַעְגַּל צֶדֶק[?] Orbitam justi, Jesa.26.7. Plural. Constr. בְּמַעְגְּלֵי צֶדֶק[?] In orbitis justitia, Psalm.23.3. Aff. וּמַעְגָּלֶיךָ[?] Et orbita tua, Psal.65.12. Foeminin. cum Aff. מַעְגְּלוֹתָיו[?] Orbitas ejus, Prov.5.21.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and forms are copied from a small scan and may contain letter errors; each marked [?]. The running head is read as Hebrew "עג" and is uncertain. "Jef.15.5" and "Hof.10.5" are printed as such. The enlarged initial in "עָגֹל" is read as one headword. No marginal notes, catchword or cont. paragraph.
